purpose: upgrade the P3 stochastic restocking dispatcher relative to the frozen slack policy (code/up_p3_vectorized.py SEL=slack, RULE=slack, q=0.60, gate=0.50, late_tol=12, no review)

split.note: seeds 2026111725..2026111729 are evaluated exactly once, after the policies are frozen on train/val; no test seed enters any search, early stopping, or hyper-parameter choice

baseline.name: slack_old
baseline.note: bit-identical to code/p3_improved_verify.simulate(case, seed, 'slack_old') on all 30 official seeds

strategy_classes: A: parametric rule search (slack coefficient, reserve quantile, EDF/ATC mix, review hurdle, blocking weight) -- joint random grid, selection on train mean, shortlist re-ranked on val

B: learned linear policy over online context features (queue pressure, remaining budget fraction, mean predictive slack, fraction of feasible set already late) -> reserve multiplier and selector mix; trained with the cross-entropy method on train seeds, early stopping on val seeds (no gradients on test)
C: distributionally robust reservation over the five official (alpha,beta) mappings: min-max (worst mapping) and CVaR(0.2) objectives on train, val check

selection.rule: for each case independently: candidates ranked by mean train weighted on-time rate over the 5 mappings; the top 5 per class are re-ranked by mean val rate over the 5 mappings; the single best val candidate per case is frozen. If no class reaches +1.5pp on val, the best val candidate overall is frozen anyway and the report states the shortfall.

gate.statistic: blocked paired difference vs slack_old. Blocks = 2 cases x 5 official mappings (10 blocks, fixed conditions); each block has the 5 test seeds as replicates. Delta_bar = mean of the 10 block means; SE from the pooled within-block variance (each block's s^2/5), 95% t interval with Welch-Satterthwaite df.
gate.passes: G1 and G2 and G3 and G4 and G5 and G6
secondary_reported: strict cluster-by-seed interval (5 seed-level means, df=4) -- conservative
naive 50-pair interval -- optimistic, reported only as a bound
gate.note: the blocked analysis is a randomised-block design: mapping and case are fixed conditions, seeds are replicates. The strict seed-clustered interval is reported alongside and is not used for the pass decision.

v1_improved.note: data/p3_improved_verify.json selected policy, 30-seed mean +5.85pp; reported as the incumbent v1 arm

budgets.note: vectorised replay only; no neural training on GPU

cost_definition: cost = sum over dispatches of (2 + 0.1*b + 0.2*D) plus 1.0 per paid re-observation; budget B per case per trial
review_definition: paid prefix re-observation 0.2 -> 0.6 -> 1.0 s, 1.0 s and 1.0 cost unit each, at most K per trial and 2 per job, taken when the expected weighted lateness-probability gain exceeds the hurdle
